name: Competitive FPS
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For tactical and competitive shooters (Counter-Strike, Valorant, Rainbow Six). Footsteps and quiet cues are lifted the moment they rise out of the ambience, while the ambience itself is not raised and gunfire is never compressed; explosion rumble is tamed so it cannot mask the steps that follow, and lateral cues are sharpened. No broadband downward compression and no crossfeed; suggested latency profile: Low Latency.
